title: Sling Suspension Versus Gym Balls in the Treatment of Juvenile Spinal Osteochondrosis
brief_summary: This study compares effect of swiss ball exercises with sling suspension exercises in the treatment of juvenile osteochondrosis in adolescent-girls
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis - juvenile osteochondrosis (according to the International classification of Diseases - ICD M 42 gender: female

Exclusion Criteria:

* any other medical diagnosis
